name: CoinGecko
description: CoinGecko lets agents read current and historical crypto prices, market capitalization, trading volume, and token data from the CoinGecko API. The public server needs no account and no key.

prompts.text: What are the current prices of Bitcoin and Ethereum in EUR?
Which of the top 100 coins moved the most in the last 24 hours?
Show the daily closing price of Solana for the last 30 days.

apps.name: CoinGecko
apps.description: Crypto prices and market data, over the CoinGecko MCP server with no sign-in.
